title: Delegated template-fallback plans reach the governed delivery-injection authority — TRUE Telegram intent no longer un-plannable (BUG 4)
description: HOTFIX-D R3-F7 remediation: persisted-provenance authenticity for inherited source stamps. reconcilePlanDataflow only re-derives consumes from prior pair_dataflow_sources stamps when ReconcileOptions.trusted_persisted_plan is set (serve-planner passes it solely for provenance:'persisted' llm_plan replay); fresh planner output and replan candidates strip reserved rows with zero effect. Even on the persisted path each stamped row must prove canonical origin against the CURRENT eligible set (artifact_id plus every pinned identity field — the same re-proof resolveExternalSourceInput performs at dispatch); unprovable forged/drifted/revoked stamps fail closed FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_EXTERNAL_INPUT. P2: consume binding resolves by canonical logical-name equivalence FIRST; the .pair/external/<id>.artifact identity-pinned alias is consulted only when no eligible source owns the name, closing the alias/CAS namespace shadow. New mandatory counterfactual tests: forged stamp on fresh input injects nothing; forged or ghost persisted stamps fail closed; legitimate PAIR-canonicalized persisted plans replay canonically identical; changed eligibility fails closed; literal alias-shaped logical names bind by name. 44/44 hotfix-d tests; hotfix A/B/C 69/69; 361/362 planner/delivery/runtime regressions (sole fail = pair-f4-delivery-provenance R5.1-crash, identical on BASE cf2674c); tsc and build clean.
